objective: Add non-terminal Quest v2 soft targets as the default useful timing pressure while preserving hard-deadline expiry, rewards, the Neon ledger owner, the existing action gate, permission gates and backward compatibility.

roles_before.artifact: Hard deadline automation and EXPIRED semantics.
No hard deadline means no automatic expiry.
Verified completion exclusively controls progression rewards.
Neon system_events is the mutable derived-state owner.
system_apply_action validates and idempotently applies writes.
PWA is read-only projection including System notifications.
Controller previously allowed real hard deadlines but had no canonical soft-target timing mode.
Base SHA is the pre-change rollback point.

role_dispositions.destination: deadline-v1 hard expiry remains unchanged and takes precedence once due.
No target remains valid when timing adds no material value; soft targets never auto-terminalize a quest.
Soft-target automation can only push notifications; it cannot award or remove XP/coins.
Target declarations use existing notification.pushed ledger events with versioned source_ref; no second store.
No SQL/action-gate/schema change; declarations/reminders use existing notification.push.
Setting/rescheduling a soft target remains exact-authorization gated.
Existing notification surface displays declaration/reminder/missed messages; core quest projection is unchanged.

skills/system-controller.md routes timing through SOFT_TARGET_SPEC: no target when useless, soft target by default when timing helps but miss does not invalidate outcome, hard deadline only for real external deadlines or explicitly accepted timed challenges.
Base SHA remains complete rollback provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: Hard deadlines still expire once server-side and suppress soft-target warnings once due.
Passing a soft target creates at most notification events and cannot create FAILED, EXPIRED or reward events.
Quests without soft-target declarations remain unchanged.
Newest valid declaration wins while previous declarations remain audit history.
A soft target later than a hard deadline is ignored by automation and a due hard deadline takes precedence.
Controller chooses no target, soft target or hard deadline based on outcome semantics rather than treating every quest as timed.
Profile, skills, attributes, achievements, shop, strategy context, auth and atomic quest resolution remain unchanged.

tests.expected: PASS including existing deadline-engine, PostgreSQL gate, HTTP/model tests and System controller routing guard.
